runtime_cases.name: deny_eq_string
runtime_cases.description: eq matches equal strings.

runtime_cases.name: confirm_neq_boolean
runtime_cases.description: neq preserves the boolean type.

runtime_cases.name: confirm_lt_integer
runtime_cases.description: lt matches an integer below the threshold.

runtime_cases.name: confirm_lte_boundary
runtime_cases.description: lte includes the exact integer boundary.

runtime_cases.name: escalate_gt_integer
runtime_cases.description: gt matches an integer above the threshold.

runtime_cases.name: escalate_gte_boundary
runtime_cases.description: gte includes the exact integer boundary.

runtime_cases.name: confirm_in_typed_boolean
runtime_cases.description: in compares only members with the actual scalar type.

runtime_cases.name: deny_nin_typed_string
runtime_cases.description: nin compares same-type members and matches an absent string.

runtime_cases.name: contains_any_first_input_match
runtime_cases.description: contains_any records the first typed match in input order.

runtime_cases.name: contains_none_empty_input
runtime_cases.description: contains_none matches an empty input array and records null.

runtime_cases.name: empty_true
runtime_cases.description: empty true matches an empty array.

runtime_cases.name: empty_false
runtime_cases.description: empty false matches a non-empty array.

runtime_cases.name: exists_present_null
runtime_cases.description: A present null member exists.

runtime_cases.name: exists_absent_false
runtime_cases.description: exists false matches an absent member.

runtime_cases.name: conditions_not_matched
runtime_cases.description: Supported conditions with comparable input can produce no match.

runtime_cases.name: explicit_null_eq
runtime_cases.description: Explicit null is distinct from an absent field and can match eq null.

runtime_cases.name: absent_eq_is_missing
runtime_cases.description: An absent eq field produces the missing-field result.

runtime_cases.name: boolean_integer_uncomparable
runtime_cases.description: Boolean true is not comparable to integer 1.

runtime_cases.name: in_without_comparable_member
runtime_cases.description: in is uncomparable when the policy array has no same-type member.

runtime_cases.name: contains_any_no_match
runtime_cases.description: Comparable arrays can produce a normal no-match result.

runtime_cases.name: contains_none_typed_boolean_integer
runtime_cases.description: Typed sets keep boolean true distinct from integer 1.

runtime_cases.name: deny_match_precedence
runtime_cases.description: A deny match wins before matching escalation and confirmation conditions.

runtime_cases.name: deny_missing_then_later_deny_match
runtime_cases.description: A missing deny is deferred so a later deny match can win.

runtime_cases.name: deny_missing_then_escalate_match
runtime_cases.description: A later escalation match wins over the deferred deny fallback.

runtime_cases.name: deny_missing_then_escalate_missing
runtime_cases.description: An escalation missing result returns before the deny fallback.

runtime_cases.name: deny_missing_then_confirm_match
runtime_cases.description: A confirmation match wins over the deferred deny fallback.

runtime_cases.name: deny_missing_then_confirm_missing
runtime_cases.description: A confirmation missing result returns before the deny fallback.

runtime_cases.name: deny_missing_fallback
runtime_cases.description: The remembered deny missing result becomes a confirm after later no-match lists.

runtime_cases.name: first_condition_wins
runtime_cases.description: The first matching condition in one list is recorded.

runtime_cases.name: reserved_receipt_fields_are_absent
runtime_cases.description: budget, escalation and session_id are absent from the historical evaluator input.

runtime_cases.name: no_policy_conditions
runtime_cases.description: Non-conditional constraints produce no conditional evaluator result.
